value.rationale: Optimizing a deterministic geodesic step on the uniform sphere is a natural spectral mixing-design problem. The exact infinite-dimensional L2 minimax is uniquely solved up to antipodal step symmetry, with two balancing harmonic degrees, a 12-dimensional equality subspace, and exact optimal k-step decay. Equatorial stepping has factor 1/2 rather than the derived 0.373938769..., giving a substantive sharp design difference not implied by generic convergence bounds.
